MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL per the supplied regime signal: volatility is normal at 27.9%, but participation is exceptionally narrow, with 0/8 sectors positive. All sector 1W returns are negative, so treat the classification as neutral with a defensive bias.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Holding & Investment leads on a relative basis, but remains BELOW TREND: sector returns are 1W: -1.37% and 1M: -8.94%; SAHOL (1W: +2.28% | 1M: -0.85%) is in RECOVERY. Banking & Finance is next, also BELOW TREND: 1W: -2.64% and 1M: -6.16%.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom is weakest, BELOW TREND, at 1W: -8.91% and 1M: -20.98%; Energy & Chemicals is also BELOW TREND at 1W: -8.78% and 1M: -21.22%. Heavy Industry is BELOW TREND as well, with 1W: -7.32% and 1M: -20.98%.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
The strongest 1W performers are ASELS (1W: +3.96% | 1M: -10.01%), HALKB (1W: +2.83% | 1M: -4.37%), SAHOL (1W: +2.28% | 1M: -0.85%), TUPRS (1W: +2.17% | 1M: -8.61%) and FROTO (1W: +1.72% | 1M: -11.52%). All five are in RECOVERY: weekly gains have not yet reversed their negative monthly returns.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
The weakest are GUBRF (1W: -23.02% | 1M: -39.45%), VESTL (1W: -20.27% | 1M: -40.17%), TRMET (1W: -15.33% | 1M: -28.42%), KONTR (1W: -14.20% | 1M: -39.04%) and EREGL (1W: -13.36% | 1M: -18.23%). All are in BELOW TREND, with losses on both timeframes.

6. Momentum Stocks?
The strongest weekly momentum is concentrated in ASELS (1W: +3.96% | 1M: -10.01%), HALKB (1W: +2.83% | 1M: -4.37%) and SAHOL (1W: +2.28% | 1M: -0.85%); all are in RECOVERY. TUPRS (1W: +2.17% | 1M: -8.61%) and FROTO (1W: +1.72% | 1M: -11.52%) also show short-term rebounds, both in RECOVERY.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance remains BELOW TREND at 1W: -2.64% and 1M: -6.16%; AKBNK (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -8.32%), GARAN (1W: -2.79% | 1M: -0.77%) and ISCTR (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -6.20%) are BELOW TREND. YKBNK (1W: -0.72% | 1M: +0.17%) is in CORRECTION, making it a relative holdout rather than a confirmed recovery.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry is weak overall and BELOW TREND, down 7.32% over 1W and 20.98% over 1M. ASELS (1W: +3.96% | 1M: -10.01%) and FROTO (1W: +1.72% | 1M: -11.52%) are in RECOVERY, while EREGL (1W: -13.36% | 1M: -18.23%) is in BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals is a major laggard, BELOW TREND at 1W: -8.78% and 1M: -21.22%. TUPRS (1W: +2.17% | 1M: -8.61%) is in RECOVERY, while PETKM (1W: -8.42% | 1M: -15.86%) and GUBRF (1W: -23.02% | 1M: -39.45%) remain in BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a defensive, selective stance; 0/8 positive sectors and 27.9% volatility do not support broad risk-taking. Favor measured exposure to recovery candidates such as ASELS (1W: +3.96% | 1M: -10.01%) only with confirmation, and avoid treating weekly rebounds as established uptrends.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Monitor ASELS (1W: +3.96% | 1M: -10.01%), HALKB (1W: +2.83% | 1M: -4.37%), SAHOL (1W: +2.28% | 1M: -0.85%) and TUPRS (1W: +2.17% | 1M: -8.61%) for follow-through from their RECOVERY moves. GUBRF (1W: -23.02% | 1M: -39.45%) remains a downside-risk watch, in BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Banking & Finance, the least-weak large sector group at 1W: -2.64%, and Holding & Investment at 1W: -1.37%; both remain BELOW TREND. Energy & Chemicals and Technology & Telecom are the key downside-risk groups, with respective 1W declines of 8.78% and 8.91%.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Specific XU100 price levels were not provided; use the latest swing support and resistance as the reference points rather than assuming numeric levels. A sustained improvement in breadth toward at least 5/8 positive sectors would strengthen the recovery case; continued zero-sector breadth or further deterioration in volatility would reinforce caution.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The supplied regime is NEUTRAL, with normal volatility at 27.9% but no sectors positive over the week, keeping the market’s risk profile defensive. Short-term rebounds in ASELS (1W: +3.96% | 1M: -10.01%) and TUPRS (1W: +2.17% | 1M: -8.61%) merit monitoring, while steep losses in GUBRF (1W: -23.02% | 1M: -39.45%) underline downside risk.
